title: 云依助手 0.13.14
releaseNotes: Manage packet templates in their own editor and explicitly apply them to the send area without connecting, sending or disconnecting. Ordinary success feedback now uses non-layout toasts; network, serial, MQTT, software-uninstall and packet-inspector errors stay beside their operation. Independent error states and stale-response guards preserve actionable failures. Existing templates, connection safety and uninstall confirmations are retained.
